intent: Implement SinkEventBroadcast exactly as tabled. EventBroadcast implemented with a Reactor Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(bufferCapacity, false) sink, capacity from TelemetryProperties. publish serializes emissions (synchronized) and returns true only when tryEmitNext succeeds; any other emit result returns false (never throws, never blocks). stream returns sink.asFlux().

methods.semantics: true accepted; false refused (overflow) and counted by the caller in telemetry.pipeline.dropped{stage=broadcast}
